headerDisplay: Homebridge plugin for AquaDaemon. Add one entry per server under **Instances** below.
footerDisplay: For help visit [Homebridge-AquaDaemon on GitHub](https://github.com/aquadaemon/homebridge-aquadaemon) or [AquaDaemon on GitHub](https://github.com/aquadaemon/AquaDaemon)

name.title: Instance Name
name.description: Unique name for this server connection. Used to namespace accessories — do NOT change after initial setup.

serverType.title: Server Type
serverType.description: Which daemon/server is this instance connecting too.

server.title: Server
server.description: Hostname or IP of the server.

port.title: Port
port.description: HTTP port the daemon is listening on.

mqtt_host.title: MQTT Server
mqtt_host.description: Hostname or IP of the MQTT broker.

mqtt_topic.title: MQTT Topic
mqtt_topic.description: Root MQTT topic this daemon publishes to. Must be unique per instance if sharing a broker.

VSP_as_Fan.title: [AqualinkD] Use Fan for Variable Speed Pumps
VSP_as_Fan.description: AqualinkD only. Exposes VSP pumps as Fans so RPM can be adjusted as a percentage. Default is on/off switch.

use_legacy_temp_sensors.title: [AqualinkD] Use Legacy Temperature Sensors
use_legacy_temp_sensors.description: AqualinkD only. Use Temperature sensors for devices reporting(ppm,orp,ph) vs Lux sensors

doser_as_switch.title: [AquachemD] Use Switch for Doser
doser_as_switch.description: AquachemD only. Exposes Doser as on/off switch vs valve. (Valve has the ability to set a timer)

no_delete_on_sync.title: No Delete on Sync
no_delete_on_sync.description: When enabled, accessories that disappear from server are not removed during sync. (Manual removal is required)

excludedDevices.title: Excluded Devices
excludedDevices.description: Device IDs to hide from HomeKit. Visit http://server_ip/api/devices to find all IDs.
